title: Capcom is preparing for a ‘future where we create games together with AI’
summary: The solution Ishida said is “successfully integrating AI technology into development workflows.” Capcom has said previously that it will not use AI-generated assets in its games, and instead would focus on using the tech to make development more efficient.
